devices.deviceString: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M1 Max, Version 26.7.1 (Build 25G241))

limitations: Headless Chromium synthetic DOM mouse/wheel gestures; window-dispatched drag moves exercise captured D3 pan but bypass native hovered-SVG hit testing and tooltip behavior; rAF intervals and input dispatch measures synchronous handler work, not hardware latency; budget counts use measured rAF intervals and the matched idle control distinguishes display cadence from app delay. Trace event durations can overlap and are not additive. Instrumented JS callbacks are not a physical-display FPS or input-to-photon measurement.

traceAttribution.notes: Native EventDispatch may omit synthetic DOM events; syntheticInput marks instrument the dispatch wrapper. Event duration totals may overlap and must not be summed. Layout nested in an input/JS event is forced-layout evidence; raster totals span worker threads, not main-thread wall time.
